SELECT n.id, n.user_id, u.username, u.avatar, n.title, n.note_type, n.location_or_url, n.summary, n.cover_image, n.view_count as viewCount, n.is_pinned as isPinned, n.is_public as isPublic, n.created_at, n.updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_like l WHERE l.note_id = n.id), 0) as likeCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_favorite f WHERE f.note_id = n.id), 0) as favoriteCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_comment c WHERE c.note_id = n.id AND c.is_deleted = 0), 0) as commentCount,
(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_like l WHERE l.note_id = n.id AND l.user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 as isLiked, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_favorite f WHERE f.note_id = n.id AND f.user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 as isFavorited
false as isLiked, false as isFavorited
FROM t_note_item n LEFT JOIN t_user u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.is_deleted = 0 AND (n.is_public = 1 OR (#{currentUserId} IS NOT NULL AND #{currentUserId} = #{userId}))
AND n.note_type = #{noteType}
AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.location_or_url LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND n.created_at >= #{startDate}
AND n.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY n.is_pinned DESC, n.updated_at DESC

SELECT n.id, n.user_id, u.username, u.avatar, n.title, n.note_type, n.location_or_url, n.summary, n.cover_image, n.view_count as viewCount, n.is_pinned as isPinned, n.is_public as isPublic, n.created_at, n.updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_like l WHERE l.note_id = n.id), 0) as likeCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_favorite f WHERE f.note_id = n.id), 0) as favoriteCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_comment c WHERE c.note_id = n.id AND c.is_deleted = 0), 0) as commentCount,
(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_like l WHERE l.note_id = n.id AND l.user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 as isLiked, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_favorite f WHERE f.note_id = n.id AND f.user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 as isFavorited
false as isLiked, false as isFavorited
FROM t_note_item n LEFT JOIN t_user u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.is_public = 1 AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.location_or_url LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY n.is_pinned DESC, n.updated_at DESC

SELECT n.id, n.user_id, u.username, n.title, n.note_type, n.location_or_url, n.summary, n.cover_image, n.view_count as viewCount, n.is_public as isPublic, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM t_note_item n LEFT JOIN t_user u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.is_public = 1 ORDER BY n.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT n.id, n.user_id, u.username, n.title, n.note_type, n.location_or_url, n.summary, n.cover_image, n.view_count as viewCount, n.is_pinned as isPinned, n.is_public as isPublic, n.created_at, n.updated_at, n.deleted_at FROM t_note_item n LEFT JOIN t_user u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.is_deleted = 1 AND n.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND n.deleted_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY n.deleted_at DESC, n.updated_at DESC

SELECT n.id, n.user_id, u.username, u.avatar, n.title, n.note_type, n.location_or_url, n.summary, n.cover_image, n.view_count as viewCount, n.is_pinned as isPinned, n.is_public as isPublic, n.created_at, n.updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_like l WHERE l.note_id = n.id), 0) as likeCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_favorite f WHERE f.note_id = n.id), 0) as favoriteCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_comment c WHERE c.note_id = n.id AND c.is_deleted = 0), 0) as commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_like l WHERE l.note_id = n.id AND l.user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 as isLiked, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_favorite f WHERE f.note_id = n.id AND f.user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 as isFavorited FROM t_note_item n INNER JOIN t_user_follow uf ON n.user_id = uf.following_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE uf.follower_id = #{currentUserId} AND n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.is_public = 1 ORDER BY n.created_at DESC

SELECT n.id, n.user_id, u.username, u.avatar, n.title, n.note_type, n.location_or_url, n.summary, n.cover_image, n.view_count as viewCount, n.is_pinned as isPinned, n.is_public as isPublic, n.created_at, n.updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_like l WHERE l.note_id = n.id), 0) as likeCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_favorite f WHERE f.note_id = n.id), 0) as favoriteCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_comment c WHERE c.note_id = n.id AND c.is_deleted = 0), 0) as commentCount, (n.view_count * 1 + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_like l WHERE l.note_id = n.id), 0) * 3 + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_favorite f WHERE f.note_id = n.id), 0) * 5 + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_comment c WHERE c.note_id = n.id AND c.is_deleted = 0), 0) * 2 ) as trendScore FROM t_note_item n LEFT JOIN t_user u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.is_public = 1 ORDER BY trendScore DESC, n.view_count DESC, n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT n.id, n.user_id, u.username, u.avatar, n.title, n.note_type, n.location_or_url, n.summary, n.cover_image, n.view_count as viewCount, n.is_pinned as isPinned, n.is_public as isPublic, n.created_at, n.updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_like l WHERE l.note_id = n.id), 0) as likeCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_favorite f WHERE f.note_id = n.id), 0) as favoriteCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_comment c WHERE c.note_id = n.id AND c.is_deleted = 0), 0) as commentCount,
(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_like l WHERE l.note_id = n.id AND l.user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 as isLiked, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_favorite f WHERE f.note_id = n.id AND f.user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 as isFavorited,
false as isLiked, false as isFavorited,
(n.view_count * 1 + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_like l WHERE l.note_id = n.id), 0) * 3 + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_favorite f WHERE f.note_id = n.id), 0) * 5 + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_comment c WHERE c.note_id = n.id AND c.is_deleted = 0), 0) * 2 ) as heatScore FROM t_note_item n LEFT JOIN t_user u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.is_public = 1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_note_tag nt JOIN t_tag t ON nt.tag_id = t.id WHERE nt.note_id = n.id AND t.name = #{tag} )
ORDER BY heatScore DESC, n.created_at DESC
